description: This Java class 'OutputContentFile' extends 'StaticContentFile' and is used to carry static content data from the Infispan cache to the service layer. It includes a ByteArrayOutputStream to hold file data with associated getter and setter methods.

classes.name: OutputContentFile
classes.description: Data class responsible for carrying static content data from Infispan cache to service layer, with a ByteArrayOutputStream for file content.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Returns the ByteArrayOutputStream containing the file data.

methods.name: setFile
methods.description: Sets the ByteArrayOutputStream representing the file data.
